arab_caliphate_abbasid_caliphate.armyName: Arab Caliphate (Abbasid Caliphate) - 750 AD to 1055 AD)

categories.name: Allies and Mercenaries
categories.description: Tibetan or Utrighur (Use Cuman or Kipchak list.

units.name: Caliph
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Amir
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Amir
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Turkish Senior Ghulams
units.description: Turkish Senior Ghulams have light armour, bow and shield. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. May have spear (+1). heavy armour (+1) and half barding or barding (+1).  Must be lked by the army general at all times.

units.name: Turkish Ghulams
units.description: Turkish Ghulams have light armour, bow and shield. Superior Shooters. May have spear (+1). heavy armour (+1) and half barding or barding (+1).

units.name: Armenian Ghulams
units.description: Armenian Ghulams have light armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. May have heavy armour (+1).

units.name: Turkish Dismounted Ghulams
units.description: Turkish Dismounted Ghulams have light armour, bow and shield. Superior Shooters. May be Riding Horses (+1) or Riding Camels (+1).May have spear (free0. May have heavy armour (+2)

units.name: Greek Ghulams
units.description: Greek (Byzantine) Ghulams have light armour, spear and shield. May use combined formation where up to half the  figures in the unit exchange spear for bow (free) and form the rear ranks.

units.name: Daylami Infantry
units.description: Daylami Infantry have a spear and shield. Shieldwall. Warband. May be designated Open Order costing 17 points per base. May have light armour (+2) and be Riding Camels (+1). May exchange spear for throwing spea (+2). May be Stubborn (+2). They may be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of ten points per base (no longer Warband).

units.name: Daylami Archers
units.description: Daylami Archers have a bow and shield. Open Order. May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of ten points per base.

units.name: Heavy Cavalry
units.description: Heavy Cavalry have light armour, Spear and shield.

units.name: Tribal Cavalry
units.description: Tribal Cavalry have javelins and shield. Evade. May exchange javelins for bow or spear (free). May be fielded as skirmihsers at a cost of 16 points per base.

units.name: Camelry
units.description: Camelry have javelins. May have a spear (+1) and shield (+1) or large shield (+2)/ May exchange javelins for bow (free).

units.name: Abbasiya
units.description: Abbasiya have a bow and shield. Superior Shooters. Evade. May have light armmour (+1) and spear (+1). May be fiedled as skirmishers with Parthian Shot. My not be used by Fatmid or Umayyad armies.

units.name: Arab or Berber Infantry
units.description: Arab or Berber Infantry have spear and shield. May have large shield (+2) and be Riding Camels (+1). May have light armour (+2).

units.name: Militia
units.description: Militia have spear and shield. Inferior Fighters. May have large shield (+2) and be Riding Camels (+1).

units.name: Militia Skirmishers
units.description: Militia Skirmishers have a shield and either sling, javelins or bow. Inferior Fighters. Skirmishers. All may be Riding Camels

units.name: Khurasan Cavalry
units.description: Khurasan Cavalry have light armour and bow. Superior Shooters. May have heavy armour (+1), a spear (+1) and shield (+1) and half-barding or barding (+1).

units.name: Turcoman
units.description: Turcoman have a bow. Superior Shooters. Skirmishers. Nomad Cavalry. May have spear (+1), javelins (+1) and shield (+1)

units.name: Naffatun
units.description: Naffatun have a shield and Incendiary 'Bombs'. Inferior Fighters. Skirmishers. Treat their bombs as javelins with no armour save. Any unit that suffers at least one casualty from one of these incediary bomb must take a cohesion test even if it did not suffer 25% casualties.

arab_caliphate_abbasid_caliphate.name: Religious Volunteers
arab_caliphate_abbasid_caliphate.description: Religious Volunteers have throwing spear and shield. Warband. May have large shield (+2) and be Riding Camels (_1). May be stubborn (+2). Every second Religious Volunteers unit may have light armour (+2). Unarmoured units may instead be fielded with Throwing spear and shiled. Skirmishers. (no longer Warband) at a cost of eight points per base

al_andalus_and_granada_taifa_kingdoms.armyName: Al-Andalus and Granada (Taifa Kingdoms) - 1009 AD to 1110 AD)

categories.name: Allies and Mercenaries
categories.description: The army may have allies from the relevant period of the Al-Andalus and Granada list.

units.name: Caliph Vizier General
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Amir
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Christian Captain
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Jinetes
units.description: Jinetes have javelins. Evade. May have spear (+1) and shield (+1). Up to half of jinete units may have bow in place of javelins (+2), in which case they may not take spears. Jinetes may be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of 16 points points per base.

units.name: Noble Cavalry
units.description: Noble Cavalry have light armour, javelins and shield. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Evade. May have spear (+1). May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of 24 points per base.

units.name: Spearmen
units.description: Spearmen have a spear and shield. Inferior Fighters. May have light armour (+2) and javelins (+2)..

units.name: Archers
units.description: Archer shave a bow. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. May have light armour (+2) or shield (+2). May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of five points per base.

units.name: Crossbowmen
units.description: Crossbowmen shave a crossbow. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. May have light armour (+2) or shield (+2). May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of six points per base.

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. May exchange javelins for bow or sling (free) or have throwing spear (+1).
